answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit bond and moors a copper-sheathed ferrous anchor at one ocean coordinate. Each epoch a beacon names a random tenth to report drift and ferrous signature within an hour. A wrong drift, reused signature, or missed check burns the bond. First fake: 38 plus a 70 bond; k-th: 38+6(k-1); 1,000 cost 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked. Rented-anchor rings fail: each ferrous signature answers only its own key. Honest agents pay 38 once and reclaim the bond after a clean epoch.
